notes.title: Demo Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Vaultframe Demo Update.

Main focus of this update is Tutorial improvement and difficulty balance.

Future Updates will be focused on bugs and Improving different difficulty Options.

V 1.2.2 Changelog

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved initial Tutorial ( Enable Tutorial on a new Playthrough to see changes )
[*] Adjusted Weapons accuracy.
[*] Reduced amount of Enemies that are spawned on the Cell next to the Core.
[*] Q-Menu now has Slow-motion.
[*] Bullet Time now affects Weapon Fire Rate, making weapons fire faster than before. 
[/list]


[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed Briefcase exploding multiple times.
[*] Fixed Enemies are moving too slow from background to player line of sight.
[*] Various small fixes on the other topics.
[/list]
